_text: [fast-paced, energetic storyteller] You carry a lawn chair DOWN to the ocean, while four-thousand people run up the hill. [dramatic] Because ten minutes ago, the moon just... blinked out. [urgent] And every phone in town says the same thing: giant wave. [proud, determined] But you're not leaving Grandma's snack *shack*. [playful] Up on the hill, Brad the realtor has five-hundred sandbags, floodlights, and a live stream.
